lines.text: Team Galactic has taken the Windworks. The fans are running flat out: every eight seconds a gust pushes everything on the path back two tiles, and the next one blows them forward.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: Commander Mars said no one gets in. That means you!

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: The plant is ours. Go home, kid.

trainer.name: Commander Mars
trainer.intro: I'm Mars, a Team Galactic Commander. We need this plant's power for a new world. You're in the way of that.
trainer.outro: Fine. We've got what we came for anyway. We'll meet again.

outro.speaker: commander-mars
outro.text: Hmph. The energy we drew is already on its way to the boss. Enjoy your little victory.
The fans wind down. The Windworks is quiet again, and the road north to Eterna Forest is open.

lines.speaker: trainer-cheryl
lines.text: Excuse me... would you walk me through the forest? Team Galactic is about, and I keep getting lost. My Chansey will stay by the path and patch me up if anything gets close.
Cheryl walks the path during every wave. Pokémon within a tile of her hurt her; if her HP runs out the level is lost. Her Chansey heals her when she is near it.

lines.speaker: trainer-cheryl
lines.text: The Old Chateau is just off this path. They say a Pokémon haunts the television in the back room...

outro.speaker: trainer-cheryl
outro.text: Eterna City! Thank you so much. Here, take this Soothe Bell... oh, I seem to have lost it. Take my thanks instead.
Behind you, the door of the Old Chateau creaks open on its own.

lines.speaker: gentleman
lines.text: Welcome, welcome. I am the butler of this house... or I was. The master kept a television in the back room that changes channels by itself. Mind the dark: the lamps light one at a time.
Lights out: towers see only two tiles unless they stand in a lit lantern's glow. One more lantern lights each wave.

lines.speaker: gentleman
lines.text: The girl in the painting? She watches the hallway. Pay her no mind.
The television in the back room flickers on by itself. Something hops out of the screen and races down the hall!

outro.speaker: gentleman
outro.text: So that was the master's little friend all along. The house feels lighter already. Do come again.

lines.speaker: galactic-boss
lines.text: This world is incomplete. Strife and emotion are its flaws. I will create a new world, one without them. You cannot understand that yet.
The man walks on into the mountain without another word. The tunnel ahead is full of Pokémon.

outro.text: As the last Pokémon falls, the air behind the altar stone tears: a purple rift flickers for a heartbeat and closes. Something is wrong with space and time on this mountain.

lines.text: Dawn runs up, out of breath: two grunts snatched her Pokédex and ran into the warehouse. Her Piplup hops onto the crates by the door and refuses to leave.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: A Pokédex? Never seen one. Now get lost.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: You again? This warehouse is Team Galactic property.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: Fine, we have the Pokédex. Come and take it.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: Last chance. Walk away or lose your Pokémon too.

outro.text: The grunts drop the Pokédex and run for the back door. Dawn hugs Piplup, then you. "Veilstone's gym next? Maylene is tough, but you've got this."

lines.speaker: leader-wake
lines.text: Crasher Wake here! Safari rules in the Marsh: no attacking! Your Pokémon can look, but they can't touch. Throw bait to slow them down, then throw balls. Anything you don't catch wanders off.
Safari: towers do no damage. Every wild Pokémon flees after twenty seconds on the path; the Bait button slows them for eight seconds.

outro.speaker: leader-wake
outro.text: That's the warm-up! Come to the Pastoria Gym when you're ready to get wet. Ha ha ha!

lines.text: A boom rolls across the water: Team Galactic has set a bomb at the lakeside. Grunts are everywhere, and the Pokémon of the lake are fleeing down the shore path.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: Stay back! The Galactic Bomb is armed!

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: Commander Saturn is at the cave. Nobody gets through.

trainer.name: Commander Saturn
trainer.intro: I am Saturn. My Golbat carries the second charge; in ninety seconds it reaches the cavern and the lake is gone. Stop it if you can.

outro.speaker: commander-saturn
outro.text: You stopped the carrier... but the first charge was enough. Look at the lake. And Azelf is already ours.
The water drains away through the broken bed, leaving mud and gasping Magikarp. The cavern on the island stands empty.

lines.speaker: trainer-riley
lines.text: I'm Riley. Team Galactic is in the lower tunnels, and the wild Pokémon are stirred up. Lucario and I will hold the exit; you take the tunnels. Watch the banner: each wave picks one.

trainers.name: Galactic Grunt
trainers.intro: Two of you? Two tunnels, then!

trainers.name: Galactic Grunt
trainers.intro: The boss wants this island quiet. We will make it quiet!

outro.speaker: trainer-riley
outro.text: That's the last of them. You fight well. Take this Egg: it hatched for me once, and I think its child belongs with you. And this... a Key Stone, with the stone Lucario answers to.

lines.text: Barry sits in the snow by the shore, his team fainted around him. "She was too strong," he says, not looking up. Commander Jupiter stands at the cave mouth.

lines.speaker: commander-jupiter
lines.text: Your friend was no challenge. Uxie is ours. Let's see whether you are any different.

trainer.name: Commander Jupiter
trainer.intro: So you did beat Mars and Saturn. It changes nothing. Skuntank, finish this.

outro.speaker: commander-jupiter
outro.text: ...Not bad. But Uxie is already on its way to Veilstone. Come to our headquarters if you want it back. Cyrus will be waiting.
Barry gets up, brushes off the snow and runs for Snowpoint without a word.

lines.text: Team Galactic's headquarters. The lake trio hang in a machine at the far end, and the Pokémon it has been fed come down the corridor with no light in their eyes.
Every third wave is a Shadow wave: Shadow Pokémon hit harder and, if caught, gain no EXP until purified at a lake.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: The machine is almost done. You're too late.

trainer.name: Galactic Grunt
trainer.intro: Commander Saturn! They got past us!

trainer.name: Commander Saturn
trainer.intro: Saturn again. Cyrus has already gone to Mt. Coronet with the Red Chain. All I can do is stop you here... and I intend to.

outro.speaker: commander-saturn
outro.text: ...Go on, then. Press the button. Let them out. I begin to wonder what we were doing here at all.
The machine opens. Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf rise, look at you for a moment, and vanish back toward their lakes.

outro.speaker: policeman
outro.text: Looker, International Police. Fine work. One more thing: a Cipher ship from Orre was seen off Sunyshore carrying what this machine made. Take this ticket; you may want to pay it a visit.

lines.text: Victory Road: the last cave before the Lily of the Valley Conference. The trainers in here are the ones who made it this far too.

trainer.name: Ace Trainer Omar
trainer.intro: You're heading for the Conference too? Then let's see what you've got!

trainer.name: Dragon Tamer Clinton
trainer.intro: Dragons rule this cave. Prove me wrong.

trainer.name: Veteran Edgar
trainer.intro: I've walked this road more times than you've had battles. One last test before the island.

outro.text: Daylight at the far end of the tunnel: the Lily of the Valley island, and the Conference, lie ahead.

lines.speaker: trainer-buck
lines.text: Buck. I'm after the Magma Stone in here, and the volcano doesn't like it. Claydol will cover the exit; you keep the lava Pokémon off me.

lines.speaker: trainer-buck
lines.text: Got it! The Magma Stone... wait. The ground is shaking.
The lava rises and something climbs out of it. Heatran, the keeper of the mountain, comes down the tunnel.

outro.speaker: trainer-buck
outro.text: That was Heatran?! I'm putting the stone back. Here, you earned this: a Houndoominite I found by the vent. Don't tell my grandfather.
